passage: "The CV error estimate for the classifier with the optimal parameters was found to be a substantially biased estimate of the true error that the classifier would incur on independent data" (abstract, SOURCES_D); correction: nested CV.
faulty: Nearest shrunken centroids is fitted for each threshold in a fixed grid of 20 values in [0.01, 1]; the 10-fold CV error is computed for every threshold on all 40 samples; the minimum CV error over thresholds (ties: larger threshold) is the statistic. Claim holds when that error <= 0.40.
fixed: Nested cross-validation: outer leave-one-out over the 40 samples; in each outer iteration the threshold is chosen by 10-fold CV on the remaining 39 samples, the classifier is refit with it on those 39, and the held-out sample is classified; the statistic is the outer error rate.
estimand: Faulty: the smallest of many CV errors, an estimate biased downwards by the choice of its own minimum. Fixed: expected error on new samples of the whole procedure including threshold choice.
model_family: Nearest shrunken centroids with a threshold grid (the source's first classifier; MATLAB implementation, Delta in 0.01-1, ties to the larger Delta).
sizes_note: Source sizes: at least 1000 training sets of 40 samples (20 per class), 6000 features each (Europe PMC full text of PMC1397873, as extracted by a tool). I use 40 x 2000 = 80k values, a third of the source's features, because 6000 exceeds the 2000-unit axis limit (and nested LOO x inner 10-fold x 20 thresholds is cheap at 2000). Reported bias: mean CV error 37.8% vs true error 50.0% on null data (bias 12.2%), SVM 41.7% vs 50.0%; the paper does not vary n, so bias against n: not stated.
exploited_structure: A tuning parameter chosen as the minimiser of the same small-sample CV error that is then reported, with many features and few samples making that minimum noisy.

structure_statistic.note_value_source: set by the brief: the statistic is genes/samples, so its value at the brief's sizes is 2000/40 = 50. (The source's own setting, 6000 features and 40 samples per Europe PMC full text of PMC1397873 Methods, would give 150 but cannot occur at the brief's sizes.)

notes: Parameter selection counts as L1.3 per the PC tie rule. Classification is the only family the source reports; I could not use another (earlier evaluations used (L1.3, classification) for VAR06 too). Guard: at least one test sample.
